newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open firm, at record levels on Dow surge.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open firm, at record levels on Dow surge.

text.p: UK shares pushed into record territory for the eleventh straight session on Tuesday, amid euphoria over Wall Street's seemingly unstoppable advance.

Dealers said the FTSE 100, which has closed at record levels the past 10 sessions and risen 18 of the past 19 trading days, could climb to the 5,000 level in the medium term but was probably due for a near-term correction.

"The trend is still up but I would still be looking for a small correction, possibly to around 4,550," the head of trading at a large brokerage said. The FTSE 100 opened at a record level of 4,685.5, up 15.9 points.
